query: /plan Implement milestone M2 (Souls and saves) from the project's Implementation Plan
notes: Regression replay of the soulcrystals M2 plan 2026-10-23-003, whose review found seven blocking defects. Run against a project with a layered module architecture (rules module that must not depend on persistence), source steps that list files, and existing gameplay hooks.
expected_behavior: Research writes a Codebase Trace row for every source item, citing opened files (damage application, death handling, input binding, data-asset definitions and baker, player character/controller), not only pattern matches
Design records the layer rule (rules module depends only on core; persistence depends on rules) and the Integrity Checks table has all nine rows, none open
A rules-side interface for the journal (a port) is placed in the rules layer before the pipeline and ledger units; the pipeline never depends on the persistence module
The file-system seam lists append, create-directory and move-with-overwrite (or an Open Decision says why not), and the save-then-rotate order is stated
A production clock has a named owner unit outside the rules module

Soul content changes list the data-asset header, the baker, the shipped assets and the editing constraint (exclusive locks), and the damage/death hooks and the controller binding appear in Modify lists
Every piece of state said to survive a restart (rotation cursor, assignments) has a writer delta and a reader handler, or an Open Decision
Unit count stays at or below ceil(1.5 x 9) = 14 without a justification, never above 18
The plan is saved with status: ready and does not state a file count that disagrees with its lists
scripts/check-plan.py prints PASS, run from the project root so Modify/Create paths are checked against the repository
